data.text: Coverage gate for the prompt hook measured and rejected (2026-09-29): 30 ordinary code prompts vs 75 answerable journal questions. No gate: speaks on 25/30 code, 66/75 journal (target among the three on 34). Gate 0.5: 16/30 vs 23/75 (17). Gate 0.7: 5/30 vs 3/75 (3). Short code prompts carry higher coverage than paraphrased questions, so coverage does not tell a journal question from a coding task. Also: 'why are events append-only' finds no decision because none is in the journal - it lives in CLAUDE.md and an ADR on disk; that is a content gap, not a ranking one.
